tool.description: Cellsnp-lite is a C/C++ tool for efficient genotyping bi-allelic SNPs on single cells. You can use the mode A of cellsnp-lite after read alignment to obtain the snp x cell pileup UMI or read count matrices for each alleles of given or detected SNPs for droplet based single cell data.

tool.help:
**cellsnp_modea**
Cellsnp-lite is a C/C++ tool for efficient genotyping bi-allelic SNPs on single cells. You can use the mode A of cellsnp-lite after read alignment to obtain the snp x cell pileup UMI or read count matrices for each alleles of given or detected SNPs for droplet based single cell data.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: cellsnp/modea - Container: biocontainers/cellsnp-lite:1.2.3--h6141fd1_2
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
